com_maxfps.title: Frame rate cap
com_maxfps.summary: The most frames per second the game will draw.
com_maxfps.details: The game turns the cap into whole milliseconds per frame (1000 divided by the cap, rounded down), so only some caps really differ, and 251 to 333 all run at the same rate. Because movement is calculated once per frame, the cap also changes jump height and fall damage, and 333 is commonly reported to jump highest. Servers using CoD2x competitive rules keep it between 125 and 250 and reset anything outside to 250; several league rule texts forbid 333.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

cg_drawfps.title: Show frame rate
cg_drawfps.summary: Shows a frame rate counter in the corner while you play.
cg_drawfps.details: Simple shows frames per second, with the lowest and highest recent values and a figure for how much they vary. Verbose adds counts of triangles drawn and texture memory in use. Time shows milliseconds per frame instead, with the same extra counts. It averages the last 32 frames and is not a benchmark.

r_swapinterval.title: Wait for the display
r_swapinterval.summary: Matches every frame to your display's refresh, which stops tearing but limits how fast frames can come.
r_swapinterval.details: The game's menu calls this Sync Every Frame. With it on, frames per second cannot go above your display's refresh rate. It is a latched setting, so it applies after the renderer restarts, and what happens in the end depends on your graphics driver.

sensitivity.title: Mouse speed
sensitivity.summary: How far your view turns when you move the mouse.
sensitivity.details: A higher number turns farther for the same hand movement. The game's own slider runs from 1 to 30 and ESL's old PunkBuster list also stops at 30; the setting itself accepts 0.01 to 100, and values below 1 are valid. The game also scales your turn with the picture's field of view, so the same number turns a little farther in a wider window and slower while you zoom in. Your mouse's DPI is separate.

in_rawmouse.title: Raw mouse input
in_rawmouse.summary: Reads mouse movement straight from the mouse while you play.
in_rawmouse.details: The macOS version of the game reads the mouse through Apple's GameController framework while you are playing and the pointer is captured. It does not apply in menus and it needs Mouse control to be on. This is a setting of this version of the game, separate from CoD2x's own raw-input option.

m_filter.title: Smooth mouse movement
m_filter.summary: Averages each mouse movement with the one before it.
m_filter.details: The game blends the last two mouse readings, which can make aim look steadier but a little slower to respond. Off is the default and TweakGuide suggests turning it off if the mouse feels laggy.

cl_mouseaccel.title: Mouse acceleration
cl_mouseaccel.summary: Turns your view farther the faster you move the mouse; 0 turns this off.
cl_mouseaccel.details: The game adds this number, multiplied by how many mouse counts arrive each millisecond, to your mouse speed. For example 0.04 at 31 counts per millisecond adds 1.24. Zero is the default and keeps every turn the same size however fast your hand moves. zPAM's mouse menu offers 0 and 0.01 to 0.04.

m_pitch.title: Vertical mouse direction
m_pitch.summary: Which way your view tilts when you move the mouse up or down.
m_pitch.details: The default, 0.022, tilts the normal way, and the game's own Invert Mouse option writes -0.022. The size of the number sets how far the view tilts per mouse movement and is normally left alone: ESL's old PunkBuster list required values outside -0.015 to 0.015. Keep the size when you flip the direction.

m_yaw.title: Horizontal mouse scale
m_yaw.summary: How far your view turns sideways for each bit of mouse movement.
m_yaw.details: The default, 0.022, is what published configs keep, and ESL's old PunkBuster list required exactly 0.022. It scales your left and right turning only.

cl_freelook.title: Look with the mouse
cl_freelook.summary: Lets moving the mouse up and down tilt your view.
cl_freelook.details: With it off, moving the mouse forward and back walks you instead of tilting the view, unless the mouse-look key is held. The game's menu calls it Free Look. zPAM servers set it back to on when you join a team.

sensitivity_mg.title: Mounted gun mouse speed
sensitivity_mg.summary: How far your view turns when you move the mouse while using a mounted machine gun.
sensitivity_mg.details: CoD2x only. Without it, mounted guns ignore Mouse speed and turn at a fixed rate. With it, this number is used in place of Mouse speed while you man one, and Mouse acceleration still adds to it. The default is 1, and it accepts 0.01 to 100.

m_rinput.title: CoD2x raw mouse mode
m_rinput.summary: Chooses how the game handles raw mouse movement: 0 off, 1 on its own thread, 2 on the main thread.
m_rinput.details: CoD2x only. With 0, raw mouse movement is not used even when Raw mouse input is on. 1 and 2 differ in which thread handles the raw movement, and no source says which is better. It is latched, so a change applies after the game restarts. This version of the game starts at 1, where upstream CoD2x starts at 0.

m_rinput_hz.title: Mouse update rate
m_rinput_hz.summary: How many mouse updates per second the game is receiving right now.
m_rinput_hz.details: The game measures this itself and treats it as read-only. It is a measurement, not your mouse's rated polling rate.

m_rinput_hz_max.title: Peak mouse update rate
m_rinput_hz_max.summary: The highest mouse update rate the game has measured.
m_rinput_hz_max.details: The game measures this itself and treats it as read-only. It is a measurement, not your mouse's rated polling rate.

rate.title: Connection speed
rate.summary: The most game data per second the server may send you.
rate.details: The value is in bytes per second. The game's own Connection menu offers ISDN (5,000) and LAN, cable or DSL (25,000). 25,000 is the highest the game accepts, and servers using CoD2x competitive rules enforce exactly that.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

snaps.title: Updates you receive
snaps.summary: How many game updates per second you ask the server to send you.
snaps.details: Your request is a ceiling: the server's own update rate also limits how often you get one. Stock servers cap it at 30 and CoD2x servers at 40. Servers using CoD2x competitive rules enforce 40, and zPAM 3 servers on stock CoD2 expect 30.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

cl_maxpackets.title: Updates you send
cl_maxpackets.summary: The most movement updates your game sends the server each second.
cl_maxpackets.details: This is an upper limit, not a promise of that many packets per second. The game's connection-speed step sets it to 30 whenever the connection speed is 5,000 or more, and the in-game Connection menu is expected to run that step. Servers using CoD2x competitive rules enforce 125; zPAM 3 servers on stock CoD2 expect 100.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

cl_packetdup.title: Repeat recent movement
cl_packetdup.summary: How many extra copies of your recent movement go into each packet you send.
cl_packetdup.details: The extra copies help when packets are lost, at the price of a little more data. Repeating does not reduce delay. The game's connection-speed step sets this to 1 whenever the connection speed is 5,000 or more.

cg_drawlagometer.title: Show connection graph
cg_drawlagometer.summary: Shows a small graph that tracks how steadily updates arrive from the server.
cg_drawlagometer.details: One trace shows how old your newest update is and the other shows your ping, marking updates that were lost. It appears only when you are connected to another player's server. It helps you read your connection and does not fix it.

cl_allowdownload.title: Download server content
cl_allowdownload.summary: Lets the game download maps and mods from the server you join.
cl_allowdownload.details: The game's menu calls this Allow Downloading. Downloads happen while you connect, and the server also has to allow them. With it off you will not get files a server needs.

cl_wwwdownload.title: Redirected downloads
cl_wwwdownload.summary: Lets the game fetch server files from a web address the server names.
cl_wwwdownload.details: The setting is shared with the server as player information, and the server only uses a redirect if it has one set up.

cl_voice.title: Receive voice chat
cl_voice.summary: Lets other players' voice chat reach you.
cl_voice.details: The server only sends you voice if your connection speed is 5,000 or more. Voice also depends on the server turning it on. The game's menu calls this Voice Chat.

sv_voice.title: Server voice chat
sv_voice.summary: Turns voice chat on for a server you host.
sv_voice.details: The game's Create Server menu has a Voice Chat switch for this. A player only gets voice if their connection speed is 5,000 or more.

r_gamma.title: Brightness
r_gamma.summary: How bright the picture is; 1 is normal.
r_gamma.details: The game's own slider runs from 0.5 to 3. Higher is brighter, and 3 is very bright. The renderer applies it through the display's brightness curve, so what you see also depends on your display.

r_picmip.title: Texture detail
r_picmip.summary: How sharp surface textures look, from Extra (sharpest) down to Low.
r_picmip.details: 0 is Extra, 1 is High, 2 is Normal and 3 is Low, the same order as the game's own Texture Resolution menu. Sharper textures use more memory. Automatic texture settings can override this unless Choose texture detail yourself is on. Rule sets disagree about level 3, so 0 to 2 is the conservative range.

r_picmip_bump.title: Surface relief detail
r_picmip_bump.summary: How sharp the textures that give surfaces their small bumps look, on the same Extra to Low scale.
r_picmip_bump.details: 0 is Extra, 1 is High, 2 is Normal and 3 is Low, matching the game's Normal Map Resolution menu. It is only used when Choose texture detail yourself is on.

r_picmip_spec.title: Shine texture detail
r_picmip_spec.summary: How sharp the textures that make surfaces shine look, on the same Extra to Low scale.
r_picmip_spec.details: 0 is Extra, 1 is High, 2 is Normal and 3 is Low, matching the game's Specular Map Resolution menu. It is only used when Choose texture detail yourself is on.

r_picmip_manual.title: Choose texture detail yourself
r_picmip_manual.summary: Uses the texture detail levels you pick instead of letting the game choose.
r_picmip_manual.details: The game's menu calls this Texture Quality, with Automatic and Manual. With it off, the game's automatic settings pick the detail, and the three texture detail settings are not used.

r_lodscale.title: Distant model detail
r_lodscale.summary: How soon models in the distance switch to simpler versions.
r_lodscale.details: Stock CoD2 protects this setting and allows 1 to 4. CoD2x unlocks it and allows 0 to 1, saved with your config, and 1 is the default. ESL's old PunkBuster list and ePAM both required 1, and ClanBase's old enforcer blocked changing it.

r_anisotropy.title: Texture filtering at angles
r_anisotropy.summary: How sharp floors and walls stay when you look along them.
r_anisotropy.details: The number is the filtering level, 2× up to 16×. Higher levels keep textures seen at a shallow angle sharper and can cost performance on some systems. Your graphics hardware caps the level the game can actually use.

r_texturemode.title: Texture filtering
r_texturemode.summary: How the game blends textures where they are stretched or seen at an angle.
r_texturemode.details: Choices are nearest, linear, bilinear, trilinear and anisotropic, and the game's menu offers the last three. Of those three, bilinear is the cheapest and anisotropic costs the most, and only anisotropic uses the angled filtering level.

r_aasamples.title: Edge smoothing
r_aasamples.summary: Smooths the jagged edges of objects; more samples look smoother and cost more speed.
r_aasamples.details: 1 is off, and the game's menu offers 2× and 4×. 3 has no menu choice. It is latched, so it applies after the renderer restarts, and your display or driver may not accept every value. CyberGamer EU's rule text asks players to check it is off.

r_aspectratio.title: Picture proportions
r_aspectratio.summary: Chooses whether the picture is drawn for a 4:3, 16:10 or 16:9 screen, or follows your display.
r_aspectratio.details: Auto follows your display. The game scales your mouse turn with the picture's width, so the same Mouse speed turns about 13% farther at 16:10 and about 21% farther at 16:9 than at 4:3. It is a latched setting and applies after the renderer restarts.

r_mode.title: Display resolution
r_mode.summary: The size of the picture the game draws.
r_mode.details: The game's menu calls this Video Mode. On macOS the list is built from your display's available modes when the game starts, so the catalog cannot list the sizes. It is latched and applies after the renderer restarts.

r_displayrefresh.title: Screen refresh rate
r_displayrefresh.summary: Which refresh rate the game asks your display for.
r_displayrefresh.details: The game builds this list from your display at start-up, so the catalog cannot list the rates. It is a latched setting, and the rate you get depends on your display.

r_fullscreen.title: Full-screen display
r_fullscreen.details: Stock marks this registration read-only. CoD2x changes its flags; native window behaviour is handled by the macOS platform layer.

r_borderless.title: Borderless full screen
r_borderless.summary: Use the native borderless window preference.
r_borderless.details: This is a macOS port registration. It belongs to machine display settings when Config Studio is integrated.

r_multigpu.title: Multi-GPU tuning
r_multigpu.summary: Tunes the game for computers with more than one graphics card.
r_multigpu.details: The game's menu calls this Optimize for SLI. Guides warn it can add mouse and keyboard lag, and the game leaves it off by default.

r_rendererpreference.title: Drawing method
r_rendererpreference.summary: Which of the game's original drawing methods it prefers.
r_rendererpreference.details: Choices are Auto, DirectX 9 and DirectX 7, and DirectX 9 is the default. It is latched and applies after the renderer restarts. The catalog neither adds a Metal renderer nor promises that any listed method is available.

r_dlightlimit.title: Dynamic lights
r_dlightlimit.summary: How many moving lights, such as muzzle flashes and explosions, the game draws at once.
r_dlightlimit.details: The game's menu offers Off (0), Low (2), Normal (4) and High (8); the setting accepts 0 to 32. More lights cost frame rate in firefights.

r_glow.title: Glow effects
r_glow.details: The effect depends on the materials and rendering path in use.

r_distortion.title: Distortion effects
r_distortion.details: The effect depends on the materials and rendering path in use.

sc_enable.title: Shadows
sc_enable.summary: Draws shadows from players and objects.
sc_enable.details: Shadows exist only in the DirectX 9 renderer, and guides report the cost can be significant. Servers using CoD2x competitive rules force them off, as do zPAM 3 servers and CyberGamer AU's old rules.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

fx_sort.title: Sort visual effects
fx_sort.details: CoD2x competitive mode forces this on and changes its run-time type and limits.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

cg_brass.title: Shell casings
cg_brass.summary: Shows spent cartridges flying out of weapons.
cg_brass.details: Turning it off can improve frame rate slightly while firing, according to TweakGuide and another guide. It does not change how weapons work.

cg_marks.title: Bullet marks
cg_marks.summary: Shows bullet and explosion marks on walls and floors.
cg_marks.details: Turning it off can improve frame rate in heavy fighting, according to TweakGuide and another guide. Marks are only visual and do not change hit registration.

cg_blood.title: Blood effects
cg_blood.summary: Shows blood when players are hit.
cg_blood.details: The game's menu calls this Show Blood. It is only visual, and guides report no real effect on performance. Newer zPAM versions also use it to show where a hit landed.

cg_drawcrosshair.title: Show crosshair
cg_drawcrosshair.summary: Shows the crosshair in the middle of the screen.
cg_drawcrosshair.details: The game's menu calls this Enable Crosshair. It controls the standard crosshair only; scoped weapons draw their own reticle.

cg_drawcrosshairnames.title: Show player names
cg_drawcrosshairnames.summary: Shows a player's name when your crosshair is on them.
cg_drawcrosshairnames.details: On by default. Servers using ePAM 1.02 force it on for every player.

cg_chatheight.title: Chat lines on screen
cg_chatheight.summary: How many chat lines stay on screen at once.
cg_chatheight.details: It runs from 0 to 8 lines, and 8 is the default. Messages also fade after the chat time set separately.

cg_chattime.title: Chat duration
cg_chattime.summary: How long chat messages stay on screen.
cg_chattime.details: The value is in milliseconds, from 0 to 60,000, and 12,000 by default. The line limit can remove older messages sooner.

cg_subtitles.title: Subtitles
cg_subtitles.summary: Shows subtitles for spoken lines that have them.
cg_subtitles.details: Only sounds that come with subtitle text can show one. Default is on.

hud_enable.title: Show the HUD
hud_enable.summary: Shows or hides the heads-up display.
hud_enable.details: The game's menu calls this Draw HUD. Turning it off hides the HUD menus the game draws on top of the picture. Game state still decides which elements appear while it is on.

cg_drawspectatedplayername.title: Spectated player's name
cg_drawspectatedplayername.summary: Shows who you are watching while you spectate.
cg_drawspectatedplayername.details: CoD2x only. It draws a 'following' line with the player's name at the top centre while you spectate. On by default.

cg_drawcompass.title: Show compass
cg_drawcompass.summary: Shows the compass, objectives and friendly markers.
cg_drawcompass.details: CoD2x only. Turning it off hides the compass and the CoD2x drawing tied to it. On by default. Servers can still affect what the match HUD shows.

cg_drawradar.title: Spectator radar
cg_drawradar.summary: Draws a radar of every player, but only for spectators, demos or when cheats are on.
cg_drawradar.details: CoD2x only, and not a player aid: the radar is drawn only for spectators, while a demo plays or when cheats are on, and only if a radar map image has been set. It is off by default and not saved.

snd_volume.title: Game volume
snd_volume.summary: How loud the game is, from silent to full.
snd_volume.details: The value runs from 0 (silent) to 1 (full volume). The game's own Master Volume slider uses the same scale. This is separate from your Mac's output volume.

mss_q3fs.title: Sound file system
mss_q3fs.summary: Set the sound driver's file-system preference.
mss_q3fs.details: CoD2x competitive mode forces this on and changes its run-time type and limits. It is not a sound-quality preset.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

mss_3d_provider.title: Sound provider
mss_3d_provider.details: The native backend supplies audio on macOS. A legacy provider name does not install or select a Windows driver.

winvoice_mic_reclevel.title: Microphone level
winvoice_mic_reclevel.summary: How loudly your microphone is recorded for voice chat.
winvoice_mic_reclevel.details: It runs from 0 to 65,535 and the default is the maximum. The game's Record Level slider uses the same range. It is separate from your Mac's microphone setting.

name.title: Your name in game
name.summary: The name other players see next to you.
name.details: Colour codes ^0 to ^9 change the colour of the letters that follow. The name is sent to every server you join. The default is Unknown Soldier.

password.title: Server password
password.summary: The password the game sends when you join a server that needs one.
password.details: The game's own password box takes up to 12 characters. Treat it as private. The catalog holds only the empty default, never anyone's saved password.

g_password.title: Hosted server password
g_password.summary: The password players need to join a server you host.
g_password.details: It appears as Password in the game's Create Server menu, which takes up to 12 characters.

sv_hostname.title: Hosted server name
sv_hostname.summary: The name your server shows in the server list.
sv_hostname.details: It is shown in server lists and can be up to 32 characters in the game's Create Server menu. It is separate from your player name.

sv_maxclients.title: Player slots
sv_maxclients.summary: The most players your hosted server lets in.
sv_maxclients.details: From 1 to 64, with 20 as the default. It is latched and applies after the map restarts. It only affects a server you host.

sv_maxrate.title: Server bandwidth limit
sv_maxrate.summary: The most data per second your server will send to any one player.
sv_maxrate.details: 0 means no limit and the highest allowed is 25,000. The server uses the smaller of this and each player's own connection speed. zPAM sets it to 25,000.

sv_maxping.title: Highest allowed join ping
sv_maxping.summary: Turns away players whose ping is above this when they join (0 is off).
sv_maxping.details: It is checked only at the moment someone connects, not afterwards, and local network players are exempt. It affects a server you host, not your own connection.

sv_minping.title: Lowest allowed join ping
sv_minping.summary: Turns away players whose ping is below this when they join (0 is off).
sv_minping.details: It is checked only at the moment someone connects, not afterwards, and local network players are exempt. It affects a server you host.

sv_pure.title: Require approved server files
sv_pure.summary: Makes players on a server you host use only the same game files as the server.
sv_pure.details: Players with modified game files are dropped. zPAM forces it on, and league rules forbid modified game files. It does not change checks on a server someone else hosts.

sv_punkbuster.title: PunkBuster (your server)
sv_punkbuster.summary: Whether the PunkBuster anti-cheat is switched on for a server you host.
sv_punkbuster.details: The game's Create Server menu shows it as PunkBuster, and the game protects it from changes here. This version of the game cannot show that a working PunkBuster service exists.

cl_punkbuster.title: PunkBuster (your game)
cl_punkbuster.summary: Whether the PunkBuster anti-cheat is switched on for your game.
cl_punkbuster.details: The game's menu shows it as PunkBuster, and the game protects it from changes here. This version of the game cannot show that a working PunkBuster service exists, and CoD2x does not support PunkBuster. League rules disagree: ScrimBase wants it on, while FPSChallenge and the 2026 Polish championship want it off.

g_allowvote.title: Allow voting
g_allowvote.summary: Lets players call votes on a server you host.
g_allowvote.details: The game's Create Server menu has an Allow Voting switch for this. The game scripts decide which votes exist.

g_competitive.title: Competitive server rules
g_competitive.summary: Whether the server has switched on CoD2x's competitive rules.
g_competitive.details: The server sets this and the game protects it from changes here. When it is on, your CoD2x game keeps the frame rate cap between 125 and 250, connection speed at 25,000, updates you receive at 40, updates you send at 125, shadows off, effect sorting on and the sound file system on, and it blocks the wait command once you are connected. zPAM 4's code turns it on in every mode, including public games. Your game turns it off again when you disconnect.

g_cod2x.title: Server CoD2x level
g_cod2x.summary: Which level of CoD2x features the server you are on supports.
g_cod2x.details: The server sets this and the game protects it from changes here. 0 means stock CoD2 1.3 behaviour, and CoD2x servers report 6, the current level. Some CoD2x fixes only switch on at certain levels.

com_writeconfig.title: Save game config changes
com_writeconfig.summary: Allow the CoD2x game to write archived settings and binds.
com_writeconfig.details: Config Studio still remains read-only while the engine runs. Turning this off is not permission for concurrent profile editing.

com_errormessage.title: Last error message
com_errormessage.summary: The text of the last error the game showed.
com_errormessage.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only. It is not a personal preference.

com_errortitle.title: Last error title
com_errortitle.summary: The title of the last error the game showed.
com_errortitle.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only. It is not a personal preference.

con_restricted.title: Restrict the console
con_restricted.summary: Requires an extra key held down to open the in-game console.
con_restricted.details: The game's menu calls this Enable Console and shows it the other way round: Yes is 0 and No is 1. With it on, the console does not open from the console key alone.

shortversion.title: Game version
shortversion.summary: The version number this build reports to servers.
shortversion.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only. The CoD2x build reports 1.4.6.8 where stock reports 1.3.

version.title: Build information
version.details: The source registers an empty string and fills it during startup. The registration default is not the eventual run-time value.

ui_dedicated.title: Hosted server mode
ui_dedicated.summary: Chooses how the in-game Create Server menu starts a server.
ui_dedicated.details: The game's menu offers No (0), LAN (1) and Internet (2). The separate dedicated-server program is a different way to start a server.

ui_netgametypename.title: Hosted game type name
ui_netgametypename.summary: The game type name the in-game Create Server menu remembers.
ui_netgametypename.details: The menu fills this in itself, and game scripts decide which game types exist.

ui_playerprofilenamenew.title: New profile name
ui_playerprofilenamenew.summary: The name typed into the game's profile-creation box.
ui_playerprofilenamenew.details: The game's own box takes up to 14 characters. Config Studio checks profile names separately.

ui_browserfriendlyfire.title: Friendly-fire filter
ui_browserfriendlyfire.details: The game's Filter menu offers All (-1), Off (0), On (1), Reflect (2) and Shared (3). This is only a browser filter.

ui_browserkillcam.title: Killcam filter
ui_browserkillcam.details: The game's Filter menu offers All (-1), Off (0) and On (1). This is only a browser filter.

ui_browsermod.title: Mods filter
ui_browsermod.summary: The server browser's filter for servers running mods.
ui_browsermod.details: The game's Filter menu offers All (-1), No (0) and Yes (1). This is only a browser filter.

ui_browsershowdedicated.title: Dedicated servers only
ui_browsershowdedicated.summary: Lists only dedicated servers in the server browser.
ui_browsershowdedicated.details: This is the game's own server browser filter, set from its Filter menu, and it is separate from the launcher's browser filters.

ui_browsershowempty.title: Show empty servers
ui_browsershowempty.summary: Includes servers with no players in the server browser.
ui_browsershowempty.details: This is the game's own server browser filter, set from its Filter menu, and it is separate from the launcher's browser filters.

ui_browsershowfull.title: Show full servers
ui_browsershowfull.summary: Includes servers with no free slots in the server browser.
ui_browsershowfull.details: This is the game's own server browser filter, set from its Filter menu, and it is separate from the launcher's browser filters.

ui_browsershownopassword.title: Servers without passwords
ui_browsershownopassword.summary: Includes servers that need no password in the server browser.
ui_browsershownopassword.details: This is the game's own server browser filter, set from its Filter menu, and it is separate from the launcher's browser filters.

ui_browsershowpassword.title: Servers with passwords
ui_browsershowpassword.summary: Includes password-protected servers in the server browser.
ui_browsershowpassword.details: This is the game's own server browser filter, set from its Filter menu, and it is separate from the launcher's browser filters.

ui_browsershowpunkbuster.title: PunkBuster filter
ui_browsershowpunkbuster.summary: The server browser's filter for PunkBuster servers.
ui_browsershowpunkbuster.details: The game's Filter menu offers All (-1), Off (0) and On (1). This is only a browser filter.

ui_browsershowpure.title: Pure servers only
ui_browsershowpure.summary: Lists only servers that require matching game files in the server browser.
ui_browsershowpure.details: This is the game's own server browser filter, set from its Filter menu, and it is separate from the launcher's browser filters.

snd_khz.title: Sound quality
snd_khz.summary: How detailed the game's sound is, from Low to High.
snd_khz.details: The game opens its sound at 11, 22 or 44 kHz; any other number makes it use 22 kHz and print a warning. Higher gives finer sound at little performance cost. A change applies after the game restarts.

motd.title: Message of the day
motd.details: Restored in the readiness integration source. The registration facts describe this build.

cl_profiletextheight.title: Profile text height
cl_profiletextheight.summary: Set the height used for profile text.
cl_profiletextheight.details: Restored in the readiness integration source. The registration facts describe this build.

sv_ratelimiter.title: Limit server queries
sv_ratelimiter.summary: Slows down floods of server-list and login-style requests to a server you host.
sv_ratelimiter.details: CoD2x only. It limits each address and the total for status, info, challenge, remote console and disconnect requests.

sv_ratelimiterrequestcount.title: Limited requests
sv_ratelimiterrequestcount.summary: About how many requests the query limiter turned back in the last second.
sv_ratelimiterrequestcount.details: The game measures this once a second and treats it as read-only. It is not a setting.

sv_ratelimiteruniqueipcount.title: Querying addresses
sv_ratelimiteruniqueipcount.summary: How many different addresses sent the server requests in the last second.
sv_ratelimiteruniqueipcount.details: The game measures this once a second and treats it as read-only. It is not a setting.

in_mouse.title: Mouse control
in_mouse.summary: Lets the mouse control the game; with it off the game does not capture the mouse.
in_mouse.details: With it off the game prints that mouse control is not active at start-up and leaves the pointer free. It is latched, so a change applies after the game restarts. Raw mouse input also needs it on.

input_viewsensitivity.title: Controller look speed
input_viewsensitivity.summary: A look-speed scale the game registers for controller input.
input_viewsensitivity.details: It runs from 0.0001 to 5 and the default is 1. This version of the game only registers it and never reads the value, so it has no effect on mouse aim.

m_forward.title: Mouse walk speed
m_forward.summary: How fast moving the mouse forward and back walks you when mouse look is off.
m_forward.details: Only used when moving the mouse would not tilt your view, meaning mouse look is off and the mouse-look key is not held, or the strafe key is held. The default is 0.25.

m_side.title: Mouse strafe speed
m_side.summary: How fast moving the mouse sideways strafes you while the strafe key is held.
m_side.details: Only used while the strafe key is held, and then turning sideways does not turn your view. The default is 0.25.

m_rinput_max.title: Old peak mouse rate
m_rinput_max.summary: The highest mouse update rate the game has measured, under an older name.
m_rinput_max.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only. Current CoD2x calls the same measurement Peak measured mouse input rate, and the README still uses the older name.

cl_pitchspeed.title: Keyboard look speed
cl_pitchspeed.summary: How fast the arrow-style look keys tilt your view up and down.
cl_pitchspeed.details: In degrees per second, 140 by default. It affects only the keys bound to look up and look down, not the mouse. zPAM sets it to 140 when you join a team, and ESL's old PunkBuster list required 140.

cl_yawspeed.title: Keyboard turn speed
cl_yawspeed.summary: How fast the turn-left and turn-right keys swing your view.
cl_yawspeed.details: In degrees per second, 140 by default. It affects only the keys bound to turn left and turn right, not the mouse. zPAM sets it to 140 when you join a team, and ESL's old PunkBuster list required 140.

cl_anglespeedkey.title: Keyboard turn boost
cl_anglespeedkey.summary: How much faster the look and turn keys work while the speed key is held.
cl_anglespeedkey.details: A multiplier on the keyboard look and turn speeds, 1.5 by default. It does not affect the mouse.

cl_bypassmouseinput.title: Mouse works in menus
cl_bypassmouseinput.summary: Keeps the mouse controlling your view even while a menu is open.
cl_bypassmouseinput.details: Leave it off in normal play: with it on, your view turns while you move around menus. Some tools and zPAM's mouse menu use it.

cl_showmouserate.title: Show mouse rate
cl_showmouserate.summary: Prints your mouse update rate and effective mouse speed to the console while you move the mouse.
cl_showmouserate.details: A diagnostic: each line shows mouse counts per millisecond and the mouse speed the game ends up using, including Mouse acceleration and zooming. It floods the console, so use it only briefly.

cl_analog_attack_threshold.title: Controller fire point
cl_analog_attack_threshold.summary: How far a controller trigger must be pressed to fire.
cl_analog_attack_threshold.details: A fraction from 0.0001 to 1, 0.8 by default. This version of the game only registers it and never reads the value.

cl_stanceholdtime.title: Stance hold time
cl_stanceholdtime.summary: How many milliseconds a stance key must be held for the hold-style stance change.
cl_stanceholdtime.details: From 0 to 1,000 milliseconds, 300 by default. This version of the game only registers it and never reads the value.

cl_connecttimeout.title: Connection attempt time
cl_connecttimeout.summary: How many seconds the game keeps trying to connect to a server.

cl_timeout.title: Dropped connection time
cl_timeout.summary: How many seconds without any data from the server before your game disconnects.
cl_timeout.details: From 0 to 3,600 seconds, 200 by default. Rarely worth changing.

cl_maxping.title: Server list ping wait
cl_maxping.summary: How long the server list waits for a server's ping reply before it shows the waiting time instead of 0.
cl_maxping.details: In milliseconds, 800 by default, and never treated as less than 100. A host's join ping limit is a different, server-side setting. This is the game's own server list only.

cl_serverstatusresendtime.title: Server status retry time
cl_serverstatusresendtime.summary: How many milliseconds the game waits before asking a server for its status again.

cl_masterserver.title: Second master server
cl_masterserver.summary: The address of the second master server the game asks for the server list.
cl_masterserver.details: The CoD2x build asks cod2master.activision.com first and then the address here, master.cod2x.me by default, on the port set separately. Current upstream CoD2x no longer registers it, but this version of the game still reads it.

cl_masterport.title: Second master port
cl_masterport.summary: The network port used to reach the second master server.
cl_masterport.details: From 1 to 65,535, 20710 by default. Current upstream CoD2x no longer registers it, but this version of the game still reads it.

net_ip.title: Network address
net_ip.summary: The local network address the game uses.
net_ip.details: The default is localhost. It is latched, so a change applies after the game restarts. Players should leave it alone; servers on computers with several network connections may need it.

net_port.title: Network port
net_port.summary: The network port your game uses.
net_port.details: From 0 to 65,535, 28960 by default, which is also CoD2's usual server port. It is latched, so a change applies after the game restarts. The game tries the next few ports if this one is taken.

net_noudp.title: Disable UDP
net_noudp.summary: Turns off the network type CoD2 normally uses to talk to servers.
net_noudp.details: Leave it off for online play. It is latched, so a change applies after the game restarts.

net_noipx.title: Disable IPX
net_noipx.summary: Turns off the old IPX network option.
net_noipx.details: Registered as a latched, saved setting, so a change applies after the game restarts.

net_lanauthorize.title: Check LAN players online
net_lanauthorize.summary: Whether players who join over the local network are also checked with the online key server.
net_lanauthorize.details: Off by default. It is the game's own switch for LAN authorization.

net_socksenabled.title: Use a SOCKS proxy
net_socksenabled.summary: Sends the game's network traffic through a SOCKS proxy.
net_socksenabled.details: The proxy's address, port, user name and password are set separately. It is latched, so a change applies after the game restarts. Leave it off unless you know you need a proxy.

net_socksserver.title: SOCKS proxy address
net_socksserver.summary: The address of the SOCKS proxy the game uses.
net_socksserver.details: Used only when Use a SOCKS proxy is on. It is latched, so a change applies after the game restarts.

net_socksport.title: SOCKS proxy port
net_socksport.summary: The port of the SOCKS proxy the game uses.
net_socksport.details: From 0 to 65,535, 1080 by default. Used only when Use a SOCKS proxy is on. It is latched.

net_socksusername.title: SOCKS user name
net_socksusername.summary: The user name the SOCKS proxy asks for.
net_socksusername.details: Used only when Use a SOCKS proxy is on. It is latched.

net_sockspassword.title: SOCKS password
net_sockspassword.summary: The password the SOCKS proxy asks for.
net_sockspassword.details: Used only when Use a SOCKS proxy is on. It is saved in your config as plain text, so treat the file as private.

cl_talking.title: Sending voice now
cl_talking.summary: Whether you are sending voice chat right now.
cl_talking.details: The game keeps this up to date itself.

cl_nodelta.title: Turn off update compression
cl_nodelta.summary: A network debugging aid that makes the server send full updates instead of compact ones.
cl_nodelta.details: Not for normal play: every update gets larger. It is not saved.

cl_noprint.title: Silence console messages
cl_noprint.summary: Stops the game printing messages to the console.

cl_shownet.title: Show network debug
cl_shownet.summary: Prints network debugging information to the console.
cl_shownet.details: Levels run from -2 to 4, and 0 is off. It prints a lot of text, which can lower frame rate. For developers.

cl_showsend.title: Show sent packets
cl_showsend.summary: Prints a line for each packet your game sends.
cl_showsend.details: A developer aid for seeing how your update rate and frame rate batch together. It floods the console.

cl_showservercommands.title: Show server commands
cl_showservercommands.summary: Prints the commands the server sends to your game.
cl_showservercommands.details: A developer aid. It is not saved.

cl_showtimedelta.title: Show server time offset
cl_showtimedelta.summary: Prints how far your game's clock is from the server's.
cl_showtimedelta.details: A developer aid. It is not saved.

cl_shownuments.title: Entity debug switch
cl_shownuments.summary: A developer switch the game registers; its name suggests entity counts.
cl_shownuments.details: No effect is documented for it. It is not saved.

cl_freezedemo.title: Freeze demo playback
cl_freezedemo.summary: Pauses playback of a recorded demo.
cl_freezedemo.details: A developer aid. It is not saved.

cl_avidemo.title: Capture video frames
cl_avidemo.summary: Saves every frame as a picture file so you can assemble a video.
cl_avidemo.details: Any number above 0 starts the capture at that many frames per second, which can slow the computer a great deal; 0 stops it. zPAM sets it back to 0 when you join a team.

cl_forceavidemo.title: Force frame capture
cl_forceavidemo.summary: Forces the video frame capture to run.
cl_forceavidemo.details: Related to Capture video frames. zPAM sets it back to 0 when you join a team.

cl_demoautorecorduploadtimeout.title: Demo upload time limit
cl_demoautorecorduploadtimeout.summary: How many seconds an automatic demo upload may take before it gives up.
cl_demoautorecorduploadtimeout.details: From 10 to 600 seconds, 60 by default. It applies only if a server mod asks your game to upload demos.

net_profile.title: Network profiling
net_profile.summary: Turns on the game's network profiling.
net_profile.details: Levels run from 0 to 2, and 0 is off. A developer aid.

net_showprofile.title: Show network profile
net_showprofile.summary: Shows the game's network profile on screen.
net_showprofile.details: Levels run from 0 to 3, and 0 is off. A developer aid.

sv_fps.title: Server update rate
sv_fps.summary: How many times per second a server you host runs the game.
sv_fps.details: From 10 to 1,000, and 20 by default. It also caps how many updates per second any player can receive. zPAM's competitive rules default to 30 and support 40 on CoD2x. It is a server setting, not something you tune for yourself.

sv_allowanonymous.title: Allow anonymous players
sv_allowanonymous.summary: Lets players who hide their identity join a server you host.

sv_allowdownload.title: Allow file downloads
sv_allowdownload.summary: Lets players download maps and mods straight from a server you host.
sv_allowdownload.details: On by default. Downloads through a web address are controlled separately.

sv_wwwdownload.title: Allow web downloads
sv_wwwdownload.summary: Lets players download files from a web address for a server you host.
sv_wwwdownload.details: Off by default. Players also need their own redirected downloads setting on. zPAM expects it on, with a valid web address, so its maps download quickly.

sv_wwwbaseurl.title: Web download address
sv_wwwbaseurl.summary: The web address players download files from on a server you host.
sv_wwwbaseurl.details: Empty by default. zPAM asks for a valid address and suggests one for people who have none.

sv_wwwdldisconnected.title: Download after disconnecting
sv_wwwdldisconnected.summary: Lets players keep downloading from the web address after they leave your server.
sv_wwwdldisconnected.details: Off by default. zPAM's server config turns it off.

sv_allowedclan1.title: Allowed clan 1
sv_allowedclan1.summary: A text setting the game registers for a server you host.

sv_allowedclan2.title: Allowed clan 2
sv_allowedclan2.summary: A text setting the game registers for a server you host.

sv_debugrate.title: Show send timing
sv_debugrate.summary: Prints how long each message would take to reach a player at their connection speed.
sv_debugrate.details: A developer aid for servers you host.

sv_debugreliablecmds.title: Debug reliable commands
sv_debugreliablecmds.summary: A developer switch the game registers for servers you host.
sv_debugreliablecmds.details: No effect is documented for it.

sv_disableclientconsole.title: Disable player consoles
sv_disableclientconsole.summary: Stops players from using the console on a server you host.
sv_disableclientconsole.details: Off by default. The game sends this setting to players as part of the server's system information.

sv_floodprotect.title: Limit player commands
sv_floodprotect.summary: Limits each player's commands to one every 800 milliseconds on a server you host.
sv_floodprotect.details: On by default. Team changes and score requests are exempt, and extra commands are ignored without removing the player.

sv_keywords.title: Server list keywords
sv_keywords.summary: Words that help players find a server you host in the server list.

sv_kickbantime.title: Kick ban length
sv_kickbantime.summary: How many seconds a player stays banned after you kick them.

sv_maprotation.title: Map rotation
sv_maprotation.summary: The list of maps and game types a server you host cycles through.
sv_maprotation.details: Written as pairs of the words gametype and map followed by names, for example a game type, then a map. The server keeps the maps still to come in a separate setting.

sv_maprotationcurrent.title: Maps still to come
sv_maprotationcurrent.summary: The part of the map rotation a server you host has not played yet.
sv_maprotationcurrent.details: The server fills this in itself.

sv_packet_info.title: Packet info printing
sv_packet_info.summary: A developer switch the game registers for servers you host.
sv_packet_info.details: No effect is documented for it.

sv_padpackets.title: Pad update size
sv_padpackets.summary: Adds extra bytes to every update a server you host sends, to test connection limits.
sv_padpackets.details: A test aid with 0 as the default. Never use it on a live server.

sv_playerbroadcastlimit.title: Send every player
sv_playerbroadcastlimit.summary: While a server has this many players or fewer, it sends every player to every player, even out of sight.
sv_playerbroadcastlimit.details: From 0 to 64, 15 by default, and 0 turns it off. It fixes missing sounds from players outside your view. CoD2x servers only.

sv_privateclients.title: Private slots
sv_privateclients.summary: How many of a server's player slots need the private password.
sv_privateclients.details: From 0 to 64, 0 by default. These slots come out of the server's total player slots, and the private password is set separately.

sv_privatepassword.title: Private slot password
sv_privatepassword.summary: The password for a server's private player slots.
sv_privatepassword.details: Treat it as private. Empty by default.

sv_reconnectlimit.title: Reconnect wait
sv_reconnectlimit.summary: How many seconds a player must wait before reconnecting to a server you host.

sv_showaveragebps.title: Show average data rate
sv_showaveragebps.summary: A developer switch the game registers for servers you host.
sv_showaveragebps.details: No effect is documented for it.

sv_showcommands.title: Show player commands
sv_showcommands.summary: A developer switch the game registers for servers you host.
sv_showcommands.details: No effect is documented for it.

sv_timeout.title: Silent player timeout
sv_timeout.summary: How many seconds without data before a server you host drops a player.
sv_timeout.details: From 0 to 1,800 seconds, 240 by default. A vanished player can hold their slot for about this long.

sv_voicequality.title: Voice chat quality
sv_voicequality.summary: How much detail a server's voice chat keeps.
sv_voicequality.details: From 0 to 9, 1 by default. The server sends this to players as part of its system information.

sv_zombietime.title: Dropped player hold time
sv_zombietime.summary: How many seconds a dropped player's slot is held before it is freed.
sv_zombietime.details: From 0 to 1,800 seconds, 2 by default. Leave it alone.

cl_anonymous.title: Anonymous login
cl_anonymous.summary: Whether you hide your identity when joining servers.
cl_anonymous.details: The game protects this setting from writes, so it can't be changed from here.

cl_cod2x_version.title: CoD2x build name
cl_cod2x_version.summary: The CoD2x build this game reports.
cl_cod2x_version.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only.

cl_demoautorecordname.title: Automatic demo name
cl_demoautorecordname.summary: The file name a server mod gave your game for an automatic demo recording.
cl_demoautorecordname.details: Set only by a server mod, and protected from changes here. While it is set, stopping the recording is ignored.

cl_demoautorecorduploadurl.title: Automatic demo upload address
cl_demoautorecorduploadurl.summary: The web address a server mod told your game to upload automatic demos to.
cl_demoautorecorduploadurl.details: Set only by a server mod, and protected from changes here.

cl_hwid2.title: Hardware ID
cl_hwid2.summary: A long identity code CoD2x servers use to recognise your computer.
cl_hwid2.details: The game builds it itself and treats it as read-only. CoD2x servers use it for bans in place of PunkBuster IDs, and reject players who send no valid one. Never edit it.

cl_ingame.title: In a game
cl_ingame.summary: Whether you are in a game right now.
cl_ingame.details: The game keeps this up to date itself and treats it as read-only.

cl_motdstring.title: Received server message
cl_motdstring.summary: The server's message of the day, as the game last received it.
cl_motdstring.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only.

cl_paused.title: Game paused
cl_paused.details: The game keeps this up to date itself and treats it as read-only. Some players bind a key to toggle it.

match_login.title: Match login code
match_login.summary: A login code for the CoD2x match system.
match_login.details: Set with a game command rather than here, protected from changes, and removed after you disconnect. CoD2x servers read it as player information.

protocol.title: Network protocol version
protocol.summary: The network protocol version the game uses.
protocol.details: Read-only. Stock CoD2 1.3 uses 118 and CoD2x servers use 120.

protocol_cod2x.title: CoD2x protocol level
protocol_cod2x.summary: The CoD2x protocol level your game announces when it connects.
protocol_cod2x.details: Fixed at 6 and read-only. CoD2x servers turn away clients that send 0 or a lower level than their own.

sv_cheats.title: Cheat mode
sv_cheats.summary: Whether cheats are on for the current game.
sv_cheats.details: Protected: the game sets it itself and it can't be changed from here. While it is off, settings marked cheat-protected refuse changes. Match servers keep it off.

sv_iwdnames.title: Server game files
sv_iwdnames.summary: The names of the game files a server says it uses.
sv_iwdnames.details: The server sets this and your game treats it as read-only. While you are connected, the CoD2x client loads only these files plus the game's own.

sv_iwds.title: Server game file checks
sv_iwds.summary: Check codes for the game files a server says it uses.
sv_iwds.details: The server sets this and your game treats it as read-only.

sv_mapname.title: Current map
sv_mapname.summary: The name of the map the server is running.
sv_mapname.details: The game fills this in itself and treats it as read-only.

sv_paused.title: Server paused
sv_paused.details: The game keeps this up to date itself and treats it as read-only.

sv_referencediwdnames.title: Referenced game file names
sv_referencediwdnames.summary: The names of the extra game files a server says clients need.
sv_referencediwdnames.details: The server sets this and your game treats it as read-only.

sv_referencediwds.title: Referenced game file checks
sv_referencediwds.summary: Check codes for the extra game files a server says clients need.
sv_referencediwds.details: The server sets this and your game treats it as read-only.

sv_running.title: Server running
sv_running.summary: Whether a server is running on this computer.
sv_running.details: The game keeps this up to date itself and treats it as read-only.

sv_serverid.title: Server session number
sv_serverid.summary: A number that identifies the server's current session.
sv_serverid.details: The server sets this and your game treats it as read-only.

r_drawsun.title: Draw the sun
r_drawsun.summary: Shows or hides the sun and the glare it causes.
r_drawsun.details: Turning it off removes the sun and the sun-blind darkening, and can help performance slightly, according to TweakGuide. zPAM sets it to off for every player when they join a team.

r_fog.title: Fog
r_fog.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. ESL's old PunkBuster list and WWCL's old rules required fog on.

r_lodbias.title: Model detail bias
r_lodbias.summary: Pushes distant models toward more detail.
r_lodbias.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. Its range is -1000 to 0, and ESL's old PunkBuster list allowed -200 to 0.

cg_hudcompasssize.title: Compass size
cg_hudcompasssize.summary: How large the compass is; 0 hides it.
cg_hudcompasssize.details: A multiplier, 1 by default. A PunkBuster stock list allowed 0.5 to 2, and published configs use 1 to 1.2.

cg_hudcompassmaxrange.title: Compass range
cg_hudcompassmaxrange.summary: How far away players and objects show on the compass.
cg_hudcompassmaxrange.details: In game units, 1,500 by default. zPAM sets it to 1,500 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudcompassminrange.title: Compass minimum range
cg_hudcompassminrange.summary: The closest range the compass draws markers for.
cg_hudcompassminrange.details: In game units, 0 by default. zPAM sets it to 0 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudcompassminradius.title: Compass minimum radius
cg_hudcompassminradius.summary: The smallest radius the compass draws markers at.
cg_hudcompassminradius.details: In game units, 0 by default. zPAM sets it to 0 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudcompassspringypointers.title: Springy compass pointers
cg_hudcompassspringypointers.summary: Makes compass pointers move with a springy motion.
cg_hudcompassspringypointers.details: Off by default. zPAM sets it to off for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudcompassoffsetx.title: Compass left-right shift
cg_hudcompassoffsetx.summary: Moves the compass sideways on the screen.
cg_hudcompassoffsetx.details: CoD2x only. It runs from -640 to 640, and 0 is the usual position.

cg_hudcompassoffsety.title: Compass up-down shift
cg_hudcompassoffsety.summary: Moves the compass up or down on the screen.
cg_hudcompassoffsety.details: CoD2x only. It runs from -480 to 480, and 0 is the usual position.

cg_huddamageiconheight.title: Damage indicator height
cg_huddamageiconheight.summary: How tall the damage direction indicator is.
cg_huddamageiconheight.details: The default is 64. zPAM sets it to 64 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_huddamageiconwidth.title: Damage indicator width
cg_huddamageiconwidth.summary: How wide the damage direction indicator is.
cg_huddamageiconwidth.details: The default is 128. zPAM sets it to 128 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_huddamageiconoffset.title: Damage indicator distance
cg_huddamageiconoffset.summary: How far from the centre the damage direction indicator sits.
cg_huddamageiconoffset.details: The default is 128. zPAM sets it to 128 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_huddamageicontime.title: Damage indicator time
cg_huddamageicontime.summary: How long the damage direction indicator stays on screen, in milliseconds.
cg_huddamageicontime.details: The default is 2,000 milliseconds. zPAM sets it to 2,000 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudgrenadeiconheight.title: Grenade icon height
cg_hudgrenadeiconheight.summary: How tall the incoming-grenade icon is.
cg_hudgrenadeiconheight.details: The default is 25. zPAM sets it to 25 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudgrenadeiconwidth.title: Grenade icon width
cg_hudgrenadeiconwidth.summary: How wide the incoming-grenade icon is.
cg_hudgrenadeiconwidth.details: The default is 25. zPAM sets it to 25 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudgrenadeiconoffset.title: Grenade icon distance
cg_hudgrenadeiconoffset.summary: How far from the centre the incoming-grenade icon sits.
cg_hudgrenadeiconoffset.details: The default is 50. zPAM sets it to 50 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudgrenadepointerheight.title: Grenade pointer height
cg_hudgrenadepointerheight.summary: How tall the incoming-grenade pointer is.
cg_hudgrenadepointerheight.details: The default is 12. zPAM sets it to 12 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudgrenadepointerwidth.title: Grenade pointer width
cg_hudgrenadepointerwidth.summary: How wide the incoming-grenade pointer is.
cg_hudgrenadepointerwidth.details: The default is 25. zPAM sets it to 25 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudobjectivemaxrange.title: Objective icon range
cg_hudobjectivemaxrange.summary: How far away objective icons still show.
cg_hudobjectivemaxrange.details: The default is 2,048. zPAM sets it to 2,048 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudobjectiveminalpha.title: Objective icon opacity
cg_hudobjectiveminalpha.summary: The faintest an objective icon gets.
cg_hudobjectiveminalpha.details: The default is 1. zPAM sets it to 1 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudobjectiveminheight.title: Objective icon height
cg_hudobjectiveminheight.summary: The lowest height objective icons are drawn at.
cg_hudobjectiveminheight.details: The default is -70. zPAM sets it to -70 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudgrenadepointerpivot.title: Grenade pointer pivot
cg_hudgrenadepointerpivot.summary: The point the incoming-grenade pointer turns around.
cg_hudgrenadepointerpivot.details: Two numbers, 12 and 27 by default. zPAM sets it to 12 27 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_hudgrenadepointerpulsefreq.title: Grenade pointer pulse speed
cg_hudgrenadepointerpulsefreq.summary: How fast the incoming-grenade pointer pulses.
